note: Core vocabularies. Profiles extend them only with namespaced terms '<namespace>:<term>' declared in profile.json vocabulary_extensions. Unknown un-namespaced terms are rejected.

levels.parton: Partons/leptons of the hard process before showering or hadronization
levels.particle-fiducial: Stable final-state particles inside a declared fiducial phase space
levels.unfolded: Detector effects removed by an unfolding procedure; the target level must be declared separately

normalization_kinds.exposure: Acceptance x time (e.g. m^2 sr s), space and ground-based cosmic-ray instruments
normalization_kinds.protons-on-target: Accelerator beam on fixed target or neutrino beam
normalization_kinds.target-exposure: Target mass x time (e.g. tonne-year), rare-event and neutrino detectors
normalization_kinds.shape-only: Normalized to unit area or a reference bin; no absolute normalization

quantity_types.flux: Particles per area, time, solid angle
quantity_types.differential-flux: Flux per unit of a variable
quantity_types.differential-cross-section: Cross section per unit of a variable
quantity_types.fraction: Ratio with numerator contained in denominator
quantity_types.limit: Interval bound on a parameter or quantity
quantity_types.resolution: Width of a response distribution (core and tails reported separately)
quantity_types.scale: Energy or momentum scale relative to truth

bin_semantics.point: Value at a point of the variable
bin_semantics.bin-averaged: Average over the bin (divided by bin width)

artifact_statuses.failed: Production failed; downstream must not treat as a result
artifact_statuses.user-supplied: Supplied by the user without independent verification
artifact_statuses.validated-in-scope: Passed declared checks within a declared scope (not physical validity)

derivation_statuses.formal-proof: Every step follows from stated premises
derivation_statuses.numerical-evidence: Computed instances consistent with the claim

missing_markers.not-applicable: Does not apply to this artifact

convention_keys.angle_definition: e.g. theta between incoming e- and outgoing mu-
